categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment for the semiconductor, LED and new display, capacitor, and lithium battery industries. Key product lines include semiconductor die bonders, LED and new display die bonders, capacitor aging test equipment, and lithium battery winding and tabbing machines. The company also produces core components such as drivers, high-precision motors, and motion control cards, supporting its intelligent manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-speed precise motion control, dual-arm synchronous operation, machine vision for defect detection, and AI-based algorithms for Mini/Micro LED wafer defect detection. It has developed proprietary technologies such as WMD high-speed mixed-signal wireless transmission and parallel computing. Production methods emphasize automation, precision bonding, and integration with MES systems for smart manufacturing and data analytics. Core components like direct-drive motors and controllers are self-developed and produced.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xinyichang serves leading domestic and international companies in semiconductor packaging, new display, capacitors, and lithium battery sectors. Notable customers include Huawei, Samsung, BOE, Changdian, Huatian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, and others. The company’s products are used in semiconductor packaging for automotive electronics, communications, memory, and power devices; Mini/Micro LED displays for commercial and consumer applications; capacitor aging and testing; and lithium battery manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Zhongshan. It serves a global customer base with some export sales, though overseas revenue declined significantly in 2024. The company plans to expand its overseas market presence and deepen global strategic layout to enhance international competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinyichang operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing advanced intelligent manufacturing equipment and solutions to downstream semiconductor, LED, capacitor, and lithium battery manufacturers. It also produces some core components in-house, enhancing vertical integration and supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing R&D in semiconductor, Mini/Micro LED, and new display intelligent manufacturing equipment. It invests heavily in developing high-precision, automated, and software-integrated equipment to meet evolving customer needs and support domestic substitution of imported equipment. Future R&D plans include expanding core component self-development, collaborating with research institutes, and advancing digital transformation of manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment and related parts to customers in semiconductor, LED, capacitor, and lithium battery industries. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, supplemented by some agency sales for overseas markets. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery, customer acceptance, and receipt of payment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xinyichang is a leading domestic player in semiconductor packaging and new display intelligent manufacturing equipment, competing against established international companies from the Netherlands, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan. It maintains a strong market position through technological innovation, product quality, and deep customer relationships. The company is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' and manufacturing 'single champion' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 933.87 million, a 10.22% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 40.46 million, down 32.91%. Despite short-term revenue pressure due to strategic transformation and contraction of traditional LED business, the company’s core business remains stable. Total assets reached RMB 2.83 billion, with R&D investment accounting for 10.45% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinyichang differentiates itself by providing high-precision, automated intelligent manufacturing equipment with strong R&D capabilities and proprietary core components. Its products integrate advanced motion control, machine vision, and AI algorithms, enabling superior precision, efficiency, and yield in semiconductor and new display packaging. The company emphasizes domestic substitution of imported equipment, cost control, and customized solutions, supported by stable long-term partnerships with leading industry players.
